## History in, dated public states out

`bench_public_transitions()` selects the latest eligible revision of each source unit.
It then selects baseline VUS and joins later states at the same condition and submitter.

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  H[Public source history] --> A[Latest complete unit revision at t0]
  H --> B[Latest complete unit revision at t1]
  A --> I[Baseline VUS inputs]
  I --> J[Match exact unit and context]
  B --> J
  J --> O[Public outcomes and later contexts]
  I --> M[Analysis method]
  M --> S[Score predictions]
  O --> S
```

Keep all contexts of one unit revision at the same availability timestamp.
A provider adapter must supply complete unit revisions, not partial context updates.
A plain snapshot is also valid. Run SCV, RCV, VCV, and arbitration tasks separately.

## Source-view contract

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `unit_id` | Stable source or explicitly mapped lineage identity |
| `condition_id` | Condition identity; NULL when absent at this grain |
| `submitter_id` | Submitter identity; NULL when absent at this grain |
| `state` | `vus`, `pathogenic`, `benign`, `conflict`, `retired`, or `other` |
| `available_at` | Public availability as UTC TIMESTAMP or TIMESTAMPTZ |

The provider owns state and accession mappings. An assertion's evaluation date is not its availability date.
History needs an explicit `retired` revision for withdrawal. Missing rows do not erase an earlier history revision.

## Keep context changes visible

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
  U[Baseline unit and context] --> E{Exact later match?}
  E -->|Yes| C[Compare source states]
  E -->|No| X{Other contexts for this unit?}
  X -->|Yes| N[context_changed; retain later_contexts]
  X -->|No| M[missing_later; no inferred benign label]
```

`later_contexts` contains the later unit's condition, submitter, state, and availability rows.
A different condition does not supply `state_after` for the old condition.
The input table contains no later outcome fields.

## API example

This example needs a caller-supplied public history relation. Rendering does not execute it.

```r
bench_public_transitions(
  con, before = "rcv_history", after = "rcv_history",
  t0 = as.POSIXct("2022-06-30", tz = "UTC"),
  t1 = as.POSIXct("2026-07-31", tz = "UTC"),
  inputs = "vus_inputs", outcomes = "vus_outcomes"
)
bench_compare_relations(con, "incremental_results", "full_results",
                        ignore = "run_id")
```

## Compare complete results

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  I[Incremental result] --> X[EXCEPT ALL in both directions]
  F[Full result] --> X
  X --> C[Actual-only and expected-only counts]
```

Both counts must be zero. The comparison includes duplicate multiplicity, NULLs, and all retained columns.
Ignore volatile columns explicitly. Matching row counts alone do not establish equality.

## Tests

Software tests cover complete unit histories, future rows, changed contexts, duplicates, rollback, and full multiset comparison.
The history test disables extension loading. UTC cutoff comparisons must work without an ICU download.
Constructed test rows are software tests, not a research population.

```sh
Rscript tools/test-implementation.R
quarto render docs/implementation.qmd --to gfm
quarto render docs/implementation.qmd --to html
```

No public-cohort accuracy or performance result is claimed here.
